title-group.article-title: Natural Language Processing for Clinical Text Mining

abstract.p: Natural language processing techniques are increasingly applied to unstructured clinical notes. Named entity recognition can identify disease mentions, medications, and lab values automatically.

sec.title: Clinical Text Mining
sec.p: Natural language processing (NLP) techniques are increasingly applied to unstructured clinical notes. Named entity recognition can identify disease mentions, medications, and lab values automatically. Prof. Lin's group used a BERT-based model fine-tuned on PubMed abstracts to extract adverse drug events from discharge summaries.

sec.title: Evaluation
sec.p: Precision and recall both exceeded 0.85 in the evaluation set. Future work includes extending the pipeline to multilingual clinical corpora, e.g. Traditional Chinese electronic medical records.
